'''2001 British Columbia Provincial Championship''' was a Star Wars CCG provincial championship held in British Columbia, Canada in 2001.<ref name="dt-15434">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/15434 Deceitful Command], DeckTech (Ryan "Cradossk" Mathison, 19 April 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/15434/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/15434/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Dates:''' 2001 (before 19 April)
* '''Site:''' British Columbia, Canada
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Winner:''' —

The event is known from players' DeckTech posts; they give no exact date. It was played before the [[Tatooine (expansion)|Tatooine]] expansion was released on 30 May 2001.

Mathison's Dark Set Your Course For Alderaan deck went undefeated at the provincials; he finished 3rd, missing the final by 3 differential.<ref name="dt-15434" />
